stem: Which sentence expresses the turning point in the story?

options.label: A
options.text: I looked at the students and gave them a thumbs-up.

options.label: B
options.text: I wasn’t the one who was complaining anymore.

options.label: C
options.text: It sounded like a great classroom to spend time in.

options.label: D
options.text: Just six weeks ago I had been the envy of my middle school peers.
